log.headline: Fixed a video call camera that kept panning
log.detail: The picture kept zooming and panning because macOS Center Stage was running on the built-in camera, and Zoom's own setting can't control it. I turned Center Stage off for the app in Control Center's Video Effects, and the requester confirmed the picture held steady.
